formula.ascii: Given the sampled distance d and clockwise-from-north bearing beta, planar p=c+d*(sin(beta),cos(beta)). On a sphere, phi=pi*c.y/180, delta=d/R, phi2=asin(clamp(sin(phi)*cos(delta)+cos(phi)*sin(delta)*cos(beta),-1,1)), and p=(c.x+180/pi*atan2(sin(beta)*sin(delta)*cos(phi),cos(delta)-sin(phi)*sin(phi2)),180/pi*phi2). Circles sample negative full-turn bearings, sectors sample their clockwise sweep with center spokes, and ellipses derive d and beta from rotated scaled axes (optionally using the arc-length table). This is the destination core for finite centers; invalid centers emit NaN.
